llm.summary: This is a coherent Pruna video-animation skill, with expected third-party media upload and some install/versioning cautions users should review.

dimensions.detail: The HTTP examples upload user-provided image and video assets to api.pruna.ai, which is necessary for the stated remote generation workflow but can involve sensitive personal media.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It recommends installing Pruna companion skills with floating npx skills references; this is disclosed and related, but users should prefer pinned or reviewed versions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The opening trigger is broad, but the artifact includes skill-boundary and when-not-to-use sections that direct adjacent requests to other skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package inspected is markdown plus a minimal manifest, with no scripts, local persistence hooks, background workers, privilege escalation, or hidden credential storage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is consistent: animate a reference image using motion from a source video through the Pruna p-video-animate API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the chosen image and video to Pruna for processing, and avoid confidential or unauthorized media. Review or pin the referenced Pruna companion skills before running the npx install commands, especially in shared or production agent environments.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad activation language is mitigated by explicit boundary guidance and alternative-skill routing in the artifact.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned companion-skill install commands are a real supply-chain/reproducibility caution, but they are visible, related to the Pruna workflow, and not hidden automatic execution in this artifact.
[SQP-2] expected: Remote media processing is core to the skill, though the artifact would benefit from a clearer pre-upload privacy and consent reminder.
[E1] expected: The Pruna API uploads and prediction calls match the stated function; no unrelated destination or deceptive exfiltration behavior was found.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The static scan reported no results, consistent with the inspected markdown-only artifact and minimal manifest.
